mapper.insert: insert into ai_knowledge_query_log (query_text, query_hash, scene, hit_count, top_knowledge_id, route, latency_ms, converted, create_time) values (#{queryText}, #{queryHash}, #{scene}, #{hitCount}, #{topKnowledgeId}, #{route}, #{latencyMs}, #{converted}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, coalesce(sum(case when hit_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as hitCount, coalesce(sum(case when hit_count = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missCount, coalesce(sum(case when hit_count = 0 and converted = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingCount, coalesce(avg(latency_ms), 0) as avgLatencyMs from ai_knowledge_query_log where create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < #{endTime}

select query_hash as queryHash, min(query_text) as queryText, count(1) as askCount, min(create_time) as firstTime, max(create_time) as lastTime, max(converted) as converted from ai_knowledge_query_log where hit_count = 0 and create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by query_hash order by askCount desc, lastTime desc

select l.top_knowledge_id as knowledgeId, k.title as title, count(1) as hitCount, max(l.create_time) as lastTime from ai_knowledge_query_log l left join ai_legal_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = l.top_knowledge_id where l.hit_count > 0 and l.top_knowledge_id is not null and l.create_time >= #{beginTime} and l.create_time < #{endTime} group by l.top_knowledge_id, k.title order by hitCount desc, lastTime desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_knowledge_query_log set converted = 1 where query_hash = #{queryHash} and hit_count = 0 and converted = 0
